name: Airbnb
description: Airbnb is a marketplace where hosts list homes and guests book them. It charges the guest and the host a service fee on each booking, and its revenue is about 13 percent of the value of bookings (gross booking value). In FY2025 guests booked 533 million nights and experiences worth $91.3B, and Airbnb's revenue was $12.24B. Growth comes from more nights, higher nightly prices and newer lines such as Experiences (supply up nearly 80 percent in Q2 2026) and services. Profit margins are high for a consumer business: adjusted EBITDA margin 35 percent in Q2 2026. The company reports a single segment; the meaningful split is geography. Lodging-tax and regulatory disputes, including a $1.3B IRS proposal and a Spanish fine, are the main open items.

businessLines.how: Service fees taken from guests and hosts on each stay or experience booked; revenue is recognised around check-in, and volume is driven by nights booked and nightly price. Revenue was about 13.3 percent of gross booking value in Q2 2026 (3.608 / 27.2, computed).
